sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **NMCG (National Mission for Clean Ganga)**: The implementation wing of the National Ganga Council, established under the **Environment (Protection) Act, 1986**.
• **Aviral Dhara (Continuous Flow)**: Ensuring minimum ecological flow (e-flow) in the river to maintain its self-purification capacity.
• **Nirmal Dhara (Unpolluted Flow)**: Focus on zero liquid discharge (ZLD) from industries and effective sewage treatment (STP) infrastructure.
• **Key Metric**: The **Dissolved Oxygen (DO)** levels and **Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)** are the primary indicators of river health monitored under the plan.

items.definition: Chaired by the Prime Minister; it is the apex body for superintendence and direction of all river rejuvenation efforts.
A PPP model where 40% of the project cost is paid by the government during construction, and 60% is paid as annuities over the operation period to ensure long-term plant performance.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Arth Ganga**: A model focusing on sustainable development through economic activities like natural farming, tourism, and boat tourism to create a circular economy.
• **Bio-diversity Conservation**: Projects like 'Ganga Prahri' and conservation of Gangetic Dolphin (National Aquatic Animal).

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Encroachment on floodplains, legacy industrial pollution, and lack of coordination between state-level pollution control boards.
• **Solutions**: Implementation of 'River Basin Management' approach and strengthening the 'Polluter Pays Principle'.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'S-I-B-A' (Sewerage, Industrial, Biodiversity, Arth Ganga).
• **Decoded Meaning**: The four pillars of Namami Gange: Sewerage treatment, Industrial effluent monitoring, Biodiversity protection, and Arth Ganga (Economic linkage).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the 'National Ganga Council' (chaired by PM) with the 'National Ganga River Basin Authority' (NGRBA). Note that NGRBA was replaced by the NGC in 2016.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Ecological Flow' (e-flow) as a mandatory keyword when discussing river rejuvenation to demonstrate technical depth.

keyTakeaways: Namami Gange is a 100% Central Sector Scheme under the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
The Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) is the primary financial mechanism to ensure the sustainability of Sewage Treatment Plants.
Arth Ganga shifts the focus from mere pollution abatement to the economic integration of the river basin.
